title: Flipper Zero
html:
Flipper Zero

Flipper Zero is a portable hardware multitool that supports the following capabilities:[1]

  • Receive, capture, and replay supported radio signals: Sub-GHz
  • Read, capture, and emulate supported NFC cards: NFC
  • Read, capture, and emulate supported 125 kHz tags: 125 kHz RFID
  • Read, capture, and transmit infrared signals: Infrared
  • Read, capture, and emulate supported iButtons: iButton
  • Act as a BadUSB device
  • Act as a U2F security key
  • Run applications and games such as Snake

For community-maintained firmware, applications, databases, and other resources, see the Awesome Flipper Zero collection.[2]

References

  • [1] Flipper Zero - Official Product Overview
  • [2] GitHub - Awesome Flipper Zero
